premises.text: Mainstream nav apps precompute routes and assume traffic does not change during a drive, so they miss true fastest paths and reroute frequently
premises.evidence_span: They assume traffic doesn't change during the course of your drive

premises.text: Richer traffic sources such as loop detectors and cameras enable minute-level traffic data beyond phone-based feeds
premises.evidence_span: much more accurate sources of traffic data besides phones, like loop detectors and traffic cameras

premises.text: TallyGo's IP enables time-dependent routing where each road segment's cost uses when the driver is expected to arrive
premises.evidence_span: time-dependent routing, where the cost of each stretch of road is calculated based on when you're actually expected to reach each turn

premises.text: Businesses that move people or goods lack embeddable real-time turn-by-turn navigation inside their own apps
premises.evidence_span: embeddable navigation simply doesn't exist today

premises.text: Redirecting users to another nav app yields an uncontrolled experience with large costs to logistics businesses
premises.evidence_span: This results in a 90% uncontrolled experience, and it has huge costs to the businesses who rely on it

premises.text: TallyGo Navigation SDK lets any company embed real-time turn-by-turn navigation with a few lines of code
premises.evidence_span: any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

value.text: Companies that move people or things get real-time turn-by-turn navigation embedded in their own apps
value.evidence_span: embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

causal_links.evidence_span: This IP enables us to provide what's called time-dependent routing
Navigation SDK, for the very first time, any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation

notes: Five SDK integration steps and LAFD demo folded into embeddable-SDK mechanism. Sensor counts are quantitative detail of loop-detector data premise. Poor alternatives (redirect/open source/build own) folded into uncontrolled-experience pain (P5).
